question: Can the saved panel_tools.1 optimized RM be compared directly against the panel_tools.2 user-held-out RM-dev scores?

historical_model.fit_role: all sampled users/targets from the historical F_RM fit partition

policy_diagnostics_rmdev.heldout_role: outcome-blind user-hash bucket drawn from the same historical F_RM fit user pool

compatibility_findings: The historical 35-column RM input schema can be reconstructed; the panel_tools.2 same-split optimized control uses that feature/parameter architecture.

The historical optimized model was fitted on all 5,475 users and 26,423 targets from this F_RM fit pool. The panel_tools.2 held-out 1,074 users are sampled from that same pool, so scoring them with the historical fitted model would reuse its training universe and would not be a held-out comparison.

panel_tools.2 therefore refits the 35-column optimized-HGB control on the identical outcome-blind 80/20 user partition and compares one extension that adds nine prefix-derived affinity/missingness columns.

The historical panel_tools.1 RM audit sample is a later V_RM block with 4,934 rows and 1,066 disjoint users; it is not the same target rows or the same held-out split as C and cannot serve as a paired C baseline.
decision: Use refit_residual_support_optimized_control as the primary same-split control. Do not report the historical all-fit model as an out-of-sample C score.
